children: Gold prices stabilized on Tuesday, October 13, on the local as well as the global level.
In Egypt, the 24-karat gold hit EGP 7,089.86 for purchase and EGP 7,027.05 for sale, according to Dahab Masr at 3:36 PM.
The 21-karat gold amounted to EGP 6,204.25 for buying and EGP 6,149.28 for selling.
Meanwhile, the18-karat was priced at EGP 5,317.93 for purchase and EGP 5,270.81 for sale.
A gold coin reached EGP 49,634 for buying and EGP 49,194.24 for selling.
Globally, the international ounce stood at $4,183.4 for buying and $4.182.9 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt hold steady on October 13
